## Summary

Auto-generated [ECC Tools](https://ecc.tools) bundle that adds **repo-local** Claude Code and Codex scaffolds derived from git-history analysis.

**Status:** 🟡 **Conditional — do not merge as-is.** Devin Review + ArchW1z disposition found generator defects and convention mismatches. Fix or regenerate, then retarget to `master-staging`.

### Intent (keep)

Give agents a discoverable repo skill + workflow command for CI gates, plus optional Codex multi-agent role configs and continuous-learning instincts.

### What lands

| Path | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `.claude/ecc-tools.json` | ECC install/upgrade/uninstall manifest |
| `.claude/skills/termux-monorepo/SKILL.md` | Claude Code repo skill |
| `.agents/skills/termux-monorepo/SKILL.md` | Codex-facing skill copy |
| `.agents/skills/termux-monorepo/agents/openai.yaml` | Codex skill UI metadata |
| `.claude/identity.json` | Suggested identity baseline |
| `.codex/config.toml` | Repo-local Codex MCP + multi-agent baseline |
| `.codex/AGENTS.md` | Codex guide (must **supplement** root `AGENTS.md`) |
| `.codex/agents/{explorer,reviewer,docs-researcher}.toml` | Role configs |
| `.claude/homunculus/instincts/inherited/termux-monorepo-instincts.yaml` | Optional continuous-learning instincts |
| `.claude/commands/add-new-gate-to-ci-pipeline.md` | Gate workflow command scaffold |

### Blockers before merge (Devin + ArchW1z)

1. **🔴 Skills unloadable** — both `SKILL.md` files are wrapped in a literal ` ```markdown ` fence and lack YAML `name` / `description` frontmatter (compare `.agents/skills/find-skills/SKILL.md`).
2. **🔴 Truncated content** — Overview ends with `... [truncated]`; regenerate full text.
3. **🟡 Command name mismatch** — docs say `/add-gate`; shipped command is `/add-new-gate-to-ci-pipeline`.
4. **🟡 False conventions** — skill/instincts claim kebab-case files, camelCase functions, relative-import-only; this tree is largely **snake_case** Python (`repo_gate.py`, `central_mapper_v420.py`). Prefer real layout: `scripts/ci/*.py`, `tests/test_*.py`, `docs/ARCHW1Z-GATE.md`.
5. **🟡 Conflicting test placement** — skill says “alongside source”; instincts say `tests/` — pick one (repo: `tests/`).
6. **🔍 Hard-coded `model = "gpt-5.4"`** — conflicts with multi-provider conductor (`.agents` / `.claude` / `.codex` / `.hermes` / `.pi`). Parameterize or mark as example-only.
7. **🟨 Security defaults** — `workspace-write` + live web + `npx -y @latest` MCPs are aggressive for a repo with session-store history; prefer safer in-repo defaults and keep secrets in `~/.codex/config.toml`.

### Integration notes

- **Base branch:** currently `master`. Root `AGENTS.md` / proposal process live on **`master-staging`** — retarget when ready so `.codex/AGENTS.md` truly supplements root guidance.
- **Root `AGENTS.md` inventory:** present on `master-staging` and on `agent/repository-hygiene` (PR #3, older security guidelines); **absent on `master`** today. This PR only adds `.codex/AGENTS.md`.
- **Gates:** any follow-up that touches CI must stay aligned with `docs/ARCHW1Z-GATE.md` (`repo_gate` + `termux_smoke`).
- **Out of scope:** replacing ArchW1z proposal process, relaxing session-store bans, wholesale MCP trust.

### Review checklist

- [ ] Strip code fences; add skill frontmatter on both `SKILL.md` copies
- [ ] Regenerate without truncation; fix naming/test/command accuracy
- [ ] Soften model pins / document multi-provider selection
- [ ] Safer Codex sandbox defaults (or explicit Operator opt-in in this body)
- [ ] Retarget base → `master-staging`
- [ ] Re-run Devin / ArchW1z review after fixes

### Optional after merge

```text
/instinct-import .claude/homunculus/instincts/inherited/termux-monorepo-instincts.yaml
```

Only if you use continuous-learning-v2.

---

**Disposition comment:** https://github.com/timerloggedout-spec/termux-monorepo/pull/12#issuecomment-5160811285  
**Devin Review:** https://app.devin.ai/review/timerloggedout-spec/termux-monorepo/pull/12

<sub>[ECC Tools](https://ecc.tools) · [Everything Claude Code](https://github.com/affaan-m/everything-claude-code)</sub>

**ArchW1z participation — disposition on ECC bundle + Devin review**

PR: https://github.com/timerloggedout-spec/termux-monorepo/pull/12  
Head: `ecc-tools/termux-monorepo-1785709008167` → base **`master`** (prefer retarget to **`master-staging`** when integrating).

---

### Answer: how many `AGENTS.md` files?

| Location | Branch / context | Role |
|----------|------------------|------|
| **`AGENTS.md` (root)** | **`master-staging` only** (not on `master` yet) | Canonical ArchW1z agent entrypoint — proposals, gates, hard rules |
| **`AGENTS.md` (root)** | `agent/repository-hygiene` (PR #3) | Older “Repository Guidelines” focused on session-store security |
| **`.codex/AGENTS.md`** | This PR (#12) | ECC Codex guide; claims to *supplement* root `AGENTS.md` |

On **`master` right now**: root `AGENTS.md` is **absent**, so Devin’s note is correct *for this PR’s base*. Root process file lands when `master-staging` promotes. Do **not** let `.codex/AGENTS.md` become the only guide — it must defer to root `AGENTS.md` once present.

Also related: root `CLAUDE.md` + `CONTRIBUTING.md` on `master-staging`.

---

### On your comment (mix/match providers across `.agents` / `.claude` / `.codex` / `.hermes` / `.pi`)

Agreed direction. ECC’s pinned `model = "gpt-5.4"` in explorer/reviewer/docs-researcher is **too hard-coded** for this monorepo’s multi-provider conductor model.

**Required shape (align with existing work):**

1. **Capability registry** (already stubbed): `docs/schemas/provider-capabilities.md` — providers declare `authenticated`, `requires_browser_tls`, tools, not a single model string.
2. **Orchestrator / conductor** picks provider+model at dispatch time; role TOMLs should reference **role intent** + optional *default preference*, never a mandatory opaque model id that breaks when unavailable.
3. Skills under `.agents/skills/`, `.claude/skills/`, and future `.hermes` / `.pi` are **adapters** to the same SSOT process (`AGENTS.md` + `docs/proposals/*`), not competing constitutions.

**Do not merge** role configs that force one vendor model until they are parameterized or documented as “example defaults only.”

---

### Devin findings — ArchW1z verdict

| # | Severity | Finding | Verdict |
|---|----------|---------|--------|
| 1 | 🔴 | SKILL.md wrapped in ` ```markdown ` fence + missing YAML frontmatter | **Block** — skills unloadable; strip fence, add `name`/`description` frontmatter on both copies |
| 2 | 🟡 | `/add-gate` vs `/add-new-gate-to-ci-pipeline` | **Block or fix** — name must match command file |
| 3 | 🟡 | Tests “alongside source” vs instincts “tests/ directory” | **Fix** — repo truth is mixed; prefer: Python `tests/test_*.py` (as PR #3 / hygiene), not `.test.` infix fiction |
| 4 | 🔍 | Overview `... [truncated]` | **Block** — do not ship truncated generator output |
| 5 | 🔍 | kebab-case / relative-import / camelCase functions vs real tree | **Block as-authoritative** — root is largely **snake_case** Python (`central_mapper_v420.py`, `repo_gate.py`). Instincts must not prescribe JS-style camelCase for Python |
| 6 | 📝 | `.codex/AGENTS.md` → missing root `AGENTS.md` on `master` | **Info** — true on this base; root exists on `master-staging`. Retarget PR or wait for promote |
| 7 | 🔍 | `model = "gpt-5.4"` | **Hold** — unpinned / unverified; conflicts with multi-provider goal |
| 8 | 🔍 | `ecc-tools.json` not in `managedFiles` | **Note** — uninstall residue risk; ECC tool should special-case or list itself |
| 9 | 🔍 | instincts `.yaml` is multi-doc frontmatter+markdown | **OK if** `/instinct-import` is the only consumer; document that |
| 10 | 🟨 | `workspace-write` + live web + `npx -y @latest` MCPs | **Security caution** — for Termux monorepo with session/credential history, prefer **read-only defaults** in-repo; put write/MCP secrets in `~/.codex/config.toml` (user-local), matching `.codex/AGENTS.md`’s own advice |

---

### Disposition

**🟡 Conditional — do not merge as-is.**

Useful intent (Claude/Codex skill scaffolds, gate workflow command, multi-agent roles), but generator quality is below the bar set by `AGENTS.md` + repo-gate + proposal process on `master-staging`.

**Minimum before merge:**

1. Fix both `SKILL.md` files (fence, frontmatter, no truncation).
2. Align command name + test-location + naming conventions with **actual** repo (snake_case Python, `scripts/ci/*.py`, `docs/ARCHW1Z-GATE.md`, unittest under `tests/`).
3. Soften or parameterize model pins; document multi-provider conductor as SSOT.
4. Codex sandbox: default safer (read-only or workspace-write only with explicit Operator opt-in in PR body).
5. Retarget base → **`master-staging`** so root `AGENTS.md` / gates / proposals exist and `.codex/AGENTS.md` truly supplements them.
6. Register as proposal item or note under `docs/proposals/` if this becomes a recurring ECC ingest path (optional but preferred).

**Out of scope for this PR:** replacing ArchW1z process, relaxing session-store bans, or wholesale MCP trust.

Happy to re-review after ECC regen or a follow-up commit that fixes 🔴/🟡 items.
